titleEn: Law on the establishment of Ministry of Industry, Science, Technology and Innovation

articles.en:
.
The Ministry of Industry, Science, Technology and Innovation is hereby established under the Royal Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia.

. The Ministry of Industry, Science, Technology and Innovation shall have the competence to lead and manage the industry, science, technology and innovation sector, including the handicraft and clean water sector, of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
- The Ministry of Industry, Science, Technology and Innovation shall be led by one (1) Minister, who shall be assisted by Secretaries of State and a number of Under-Secretaries of State as necessary.
. - The organisation and functioning of the Ministry of Industry, Science, Technology and Innovation shall be determined by sub-decree.
. - Laws and legal instruments relating to the industry and handicraft sector that are in force shall continue to have effect until re-determined in accordance with the provisions of this Law.

. - Legal instruments relating to the implementation of the Law on the Establishment of the Ministry of Industry and Handicraft and the sub-decree on the organisation and functioning of the Ministry of Industry and Handicraft shall continue to have effect until new legal instruments are adopted in substitution therefor in accordance with the provisions of this Law.

. - The Law on the Establishment of the Ministry of Industry and Handicraft, promulgated by Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/1213/018 dated 9 December 2013, is hereby repealed, and any provisions contrary thereto shall be considered null and void.
[Illegible in source]

This Law is declared to be urgent.
Done at the Royal Palace, 26 March 2020, [lunar calendar date, Buddhist Era 2563]; Royal signature and seal, Norodom Sihamoni,
having respectfully submitted to the King for signature; Prime Minister, Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen
